# TableCell

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

A table cell with support for custom styling, background color, and padding overrides

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `BorderedElementBase`. Implements `IRoleProvider`.

## Properties

- [`Color`](#color): TextBlock color for this cell
- [`ColumnSpan`](#columnspan): Number of columns this cell spans (default: 1)
- [`Content`](#content): The content element to display in this cell
- [`IsHeader`](#isheader): Whether this cell is a header cell (renders as `/TH` in PDF/UA tagged output instead of `/TD`).
- [`Padding`](#padding): Custom padding for this cell (overrides table default if set)
- [`SemanticRole`](#semanticrole): `TH` for a header cell, otherwise `TD`.
- [`VerticalAlignment`](#verticalalignment): Vertical placement of the content within the row.

### `IsHeader`

```csharp
bool IsHeader { get; set; }
```

Whether this cell is a header cell (renders as `/TH` in PDF/UA tagged output instead of `/TD`). Set automatically by `AddHeader` on each cell in a header row, and at render time from the owning row's `IsHeader` flag for cells added directly to a row. May also be set explicitly for individual cells that act as headers (e.g. row headers in the first column of a data row).
